'''2007 Worlds Team Joseph Graham DS My Kind Of Scum''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Joseph Graham]] at [[2007 World Championship]] (Team).

DS Team Texas 1. Reels→Weequay (OCR). Fe Hipern→Fel'Shung Stun Rifle. 10 shields.


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Joseph Graham]]
* '''Event:''' [[2007 World Championship]]
* '''Format:''' [[Virtual Sets (2002-2009)|Decipher + Virtual Sets (2002-2009)]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' [[My Kind Of Scum / Fearless And Inventive|My Kind Of Scum]]
* '''Stage:''' Team
